title: Steps may depend on a step of another repository (repo:STEP-ID)
goal: A component records a cross-repository step prerequisite without reading the other repository
acceptance: check:work accepts `<repo>:<STEP-ID>` in a task's dependsOn as an external prerequisite: valid syntax, never resolved, no cycle check
The step waits (⏳) until its externalMet lists the reference; Depends on cells show it, linked when workItems.externalRepositories names the repository
Malformed references, record IDs and externalMet outside dependsOn are refused; fixture tests; ordering, parallel-work and solution-profile docs; CHANGELOG
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A form the coordinator could not resolve unambiguously goes to the owner before release

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-24; independent review, CI and release remain.
